finding: The word rule's lookahead and colon lookbehind are not pinned by any pass case, so the new cases pin only the hyphen lookbehind.
why: Each pass case is also blocked by a second guard, so removing the lookahead or the colon in the lookbehind leaves every test green.
fix: Add pass cases that only one guard can reject.
evidence: The reviewer mutation probe: mutants lookahead removed, lookahead without hyphen, lookahead without colon, lookbehind without colon each leave 0 fail-list lines unflagged and no extra pass-list lines flagged.
